criteria.description: res.send does not generate Content-Length alongside a retained Transfer-Encoding header, for any transfer-coding value. Preserve status-specific header removal/replacement, including Content-Length: 0 after removing Transfer-Encoding for HTTP 205.
Body conversion, content type, ETag generation including with Transfer-Encoding, freshness, status-specific header removal, HEAD handling, and response completion retain existing behavior.

criteria.evaluator_guidance: The dependency image contains the resolved Bun cache. Run bun install --offline --no-save in the candidate copy before invoking Express or Mocha; never use the network during grading. Inspect /reference/index.json and the relevant upstream patches. Both define the requested outcome. The frozen ancestry contains 18 commits, but unrelated QUERY support, dependency, CI, and documentation changes are context, not task requirements. Keep baseline behavior outside res.send's requested change. Assess focused regression tests and accept equivalent implementations and safe improvements without exact patch or file-boundary requirements. Reference evidence is evaluator-only.
